projects.title: Datalink Encryption and Authentication for Airsim
projects.description: ACARS (Aircraft Communications Addressing and Reporting System), otherwise known as Datalink, is the transmission of messages between aircraft and ground stations via VHF (Very High Frequency) or SATCOM. The transmitted messages can be intercepted by the public with the correct antenna equipment. Therefore, a need for encryption of these messages exists in order to protect sensitive data that is being transmitted. Airsim is a software package that is able to simulate a datalink system on a PC, as if it was installed on an aircraft. The project's purpose was to create a console application that would be able to decrypt encrypted ACARS messages. Using Microsoft Visual Studios and C++, a program was created to accept encrypted messages in the ASCII .txt file format, decrypt the message using a decryption algorithm, and export the decrypted (original) message into the ASCII .txt file format.
